topic: Countries ranked by production of pumpkins, squash and gourds (FAOSTAT, 2024)

sources.title: FAOSTAT Production: Crops and livestock products, bulk download (normalized), file dated 2025-12-23; item 394 Pumpkins, squash and gourds (quotes verified against the item's rows extracted from the file, cached in build/sources/fao_qcl.txt)
sources.publisher: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)

claims.text: India produced 9,330,691 tonnes of pumpkins, squash and gourds in 2024 (about 9.3 million, an official figure), the most of any country.
claims.quote: 100 356 India 394 01235 Pumpkins, squash and gourds 5510 Production 2024 2024 t 9330691.000000 A

claims.label: FAO estimate
claims.text: Mainland China produced about 7.65 million tonnes in 2024 (about 7.7; FAO estimate), second.
claims.quote: 41 156 China, mainland 394 01235 Pumpkins, squash and gourds 5510 Production 2024 2024 t 7652951.980000 E

claims.label: FAO estimate
claims.text: Egypt produced about 1.28 million tonnes in 2024 (about 1.3; imputed by FAO), third.
claims.quote: 59 818 Egypt 394 01235 Pumpkins, squash and gourds 5510 Production 2024 2024 t 1275382.720000 I

claims.label: FAO estimate
claims.text: Russia produced about 1.16 million tonnes in 2024 (a little over a million; imputed by FAO), fourth.
claims.quote: 185 643 Russian Federation 394 01235 Pumpkins, squash and gourds 5510 Production 2024 2024 t 1163234.890000 I

claims.label: FAO estimate
claims.text: Ukraine produced about 1.11 million tonnes in 2024 (a little over a million; FAO estimate), fifth.
claims.quote: 230 804 Ukraine 394 01235 Pumpkins, squash and gourds 5510 Production 2024 2024 t 1105900.000000 E

claims.text: The United States produced 934,922 tonnes in 2024 (about nine hundred thirty-five thousand; official), sixth; India's figure is about ten times it (9.98).
claims.quote: 231 840 United States of America 394 01235 Pumpkins, squash and gourds 5510 Production 2024 2024 t 934922.000000 A

claims.text: FAO counts pumpkins, squash and gourds as one item; flag E means an estimated value and I a value imputed by a receiving agency.
claims.quote: 394 01235 Pumpkins, squash and gourds 5510 Production; E,Estimated value; I,Value imputed by a receiving agency

myths.myth: The US, home of the jack-o'-lantern, grows the most pumpkins.
myths.truth: In FAOSTAT 2024 the US is sixth; India grows about ten times as much (pumpkins, squash and gourds).

open_questions: FAO's item mixes pumpkins with squash and gourds; no country-level split for carving pumpkins exists in FAOSTAT.
